name: HarnessRouter v0.38 API for Coding Agents (Codex, Claude Code)
description: Self-hosted API and console for Codex, Claude Code, Hermes and Pi agents.

PORT.description: Port of the HarnessRouter console (UI and API); the public domain and the healthcheck use it.

HR_AUTH_USER.description: Console username. A username saved later under Profile replaces it.

HR_AUTH_PASSWORD.description: Console password, generated at deploy; copy it from here to sign in. A password saved under Profile replaces it.

HR_SECRET_KEY.description: Encrypts stored provider keys and tokens on the volume. Generated; never change or delete it, or saved keys become unreadable.

HR_BACKENDS.description: Agent harness CLIs installed into the volume at start (comma-separated). Each adds disk; see the README for the full list.

ANTHROPIC_API_KEY.description: Optional Anthropic API key, used as an environment connection (Claude Code and others). Or add keys in the console.

OPENAI_API_KEY.description: Optional OpenAI API key, used as an environment connection (Codex and others). Or add keys in the console.

GEMINI_API_KEY.description: Optional Google AI Studio API key, used as an environment connection (Gemini CLI and others).

OPENROUTER_API_KEY.description: Optional OpenRouter API key, used as an environment connection after any direct vendor key.

HARNESS_GLOBAL_CONCURRENCY.description: Optional cap on agent turns running at once. Empty = the service CPU limit, between 2 and 4. Extra turns wait.

HR_WORKSPACE_TTL_HOURS.description: Idle session workspaces are removed after this many hours (they restore from checkpoints). 0 keeps them forever.

RAILWAY_DEPLOYMENT_DRAINING_SECONDS.description: Grace period for the console, gateway and runner to stop cleanly on redeploy.
